content: MCP client stdio spawn differences: servers inherit only a minimal, platform-dependent env subset (not the user's shell env) — PATH from GUI-launched clients often misses nvm/volta node; env must be passed explicitly via config env key; cwd at spawn is client-defined (often / or the app dir, per-workspace in some IDEs) so relative paths to sibling files break — resolve everything from import.meta.url; Windows requires cmd /c wrappers for npx across Claude Code/Cursor/Cline/Windsurf trackers.
